verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a local runtime, and its own site claims voice support with real-time-feeling "speech in ... over WebRTC", which implies on-device speech recognition. However, the evidence never documents a transcription endpoint, a dictation-to-text flow, or which speech-to-text models are used; the speech-in claim is framed as a voice-agent conversation rather than dictation. missing for 10: explicit speech-to-text/transcription documentation, a streaming dictation workflow that outputs text, named on-device STT models, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate speech that gets transcribed in real time by an on-device model

citations.quote: Speech in, tool calls in the middle, speech out over WebRTC, fast enough to feel like a conversation.
Text, voice, vision, images, video, 3D and agents, from one open runtime.
Every feature ships a CPU path first.
